zh-TW.category: 開源・自架・多角色有聲書
zh-TW.headline: 把你的故事，
zh-TW.summary: StoryVoice 是開源、自架的多角色有聲書工作室。匯入 EPUB 或 TXT，整理角色與台詞、安排聲線，審核後產生有聲書。
zh-TW.audienceHeading: 從一篇故事，到一整套作品
zh-TW.audienceIntro: 想做自己的有聲書，或替團隊建立製作流程，都能從同一份角色設定開始。

audiences.title: 小說與故事創作者
audiences.description: 把自己創作或獲授權的文字做成有聲書，先試聽，再調整每個角色的演出。

audiences.title: 系列作品製作團隊
audiences.description: 多冊作品共用角色與聲線；台詞逐章校對，換版時保留已完成的音訊。

audiences.title: 自架使用者與開發者
audiences.description: 在自己的環境管理書庫，依需求配置本機模型、語音服務或串接 API。

zh-TW.workflowHeading: 四個步驟，把文字變成有聲書
zh-TW.workflowIntro: 先選一章試做，確認角色和聲音合適，再製作整本。

steps.title: 匯入故事
steps.description: 上傳有權使用、無 DRM 的 EPUB 或 UTF-8 TXT，整理章節與原文。

steps.title: 安排角色
steps.description: 檢查 AI 建議的角色與說話者，替旁白和角色選擇聲線。
steps.result: 建立可跨冊沿用的卡司

steps.title: 審核與試聽
steps.description: 逐章確認台詞歸屬；支援的聲線可以單句試聽，不確定的地方由你修正。
steps.result: 留下確認過的配音劇本

steps.title: 產生與聆聽
steps.description: 建立朗讀工作、查看進度，完成後播放或下載 MP3。

zh-TW.featureHeading: 角色、劇本、音檔，放在一起管理
zh-TW.featureIntro: 從角色設定到完成的音檔都留有記錄，下次製作或修改時可以接著用。

features.title: 角色聲線，跨冊保持一致
features.description: 角色資料與聲線可以重複使用，同一系列沿用同一套卡司。支援的語音服務也能配置情境聲線。

features.title: 誰在說話，由你確認
features.description: AI 輔助整理旁白、對話與說話者。你可以修正角色歸屬、接受建議，確認劇本後再製作。
features.detail: AI 輔助 / 人工審核

features.title: 看得到進度，也能重試與換版
features.description: 朗讀工作支援查看進度、取消與重試。系列重建先產生候選版本，完成並確認後才切換。
features.detail: 工作進度 / 版本確認

features.title: 整理書庫，也能分享閱讀
features.description: 用書冊把作品排好順序，依已註冊帳號的 email 分享唯讀書冊。分享範圍不包含私人筆記與朗讀音訊。
features.detail: 書冊管理 / 唯讀分享

zh-TW.factsHeading: 開始之前，先知道這幾件事

facts.label: 輸入與輸出
facts.value: 輸入 EPUB、UTF-8 TXT；有聲書輸出 MP3。

facts.label: 語言與聲線
facts.value: 目前以繁體中文內容、台灣華語製作為主；可用聲線依部署設定與語音服務而定。

facts.label: 部署與費用
facts.value: MIT 開源，可自行部署。伺服器、GPU 與外部語音服務的成本須另行評估。

facts.label: 內容與資料
facts.value: 僅處理自有或獲授權的內容，不提供 DRM 規避。使用外部模型或語音服務時，相關文字或音訊會送往該服務。

faqs.question: 一定要先設定多角色嗎？
faqs.answer: 不一定。你可以先匯入書籍，以部署環境提供的單一聲線朗讀；需要角色演出時，再建立系列卡司與配音劇本。

faqs.question: AI 會把角色和台詞全部判斷正確嗎？
faqs.answer: 不能保證。AI 會提供角色與說話者建議，低信心或有歧義的段落仍需要人工檢查；你可以修改歸屬後再確認。

faqs.question: 能替角色建立自己的聲音嗎？
faqs.answer: 角色聲線工作室支援建立與管理自訂聲線，但實際可用能力取決於部署的語音服務、樣本及授權條件。請先試聽再用於整本製作。

faqs.question: 安裝後就能使用所有 AI 功能嗎？
faqs.answer: 還需要完成模型與語音服務設定。本機 LLM、GPU 語音、公開聲線目錄和開發者 API 各有啟用條件，頁面會依實際可用狀態顯示。

faqs.question: 書籍和音檔會公開嗎？
faqs.answer: 工作區需登入，書籍與產生的音檔依帳號限制存取。你可以主動分享唯讀書冊；自架不代表所有運算都在本機，資料流向仍取決於所選的模型與語音服務。

en.headline: Turn your story into
en.summary: StoryVoice is an open-source, self-hosted AI audiobook studio. Import EPUB or TXT, organize characters and dialogue, cast voices, and review the script before generating an audiobook.
en.audienceHeading: For a short story or a whole series
en.audienceIntro: Start with a reusable cast, whether you are making your own audiobook or building a production workflow for a team.

audiences.title: Authors and storytellers
audiences.description: Turn your own or licensed writing into audio. Audition the voices and adjust each character before producing the book.

audiences.title: Series production teams
audiences.description: Reuse characters and voices across books, review dialogue chapter by chapter, and retain finished audio while preparing a new version.

audiences.title: Self-hosters and developers
audiences.description: Manage a library in your own environment. Configure local models, speech services, or API integrations to fit your workflow.

en.workflowHeading: From manuscript to audiobook in four steps
en.workflowIntro: Try one chapter first. Check the cast and voices before producing the whole book.

steps.title: Import your story
steps.description: Upload an authorized, DRM-free EPUB or UTF-8 TXT file to organize chapters and source text.

steps.title: Cast the voices
steps.description: Check AI suggestions for characters and speakers. Assign voices to your narrator and cast.
steps.result: A cast you can reuse across books

steps.title: Review and audition
steps.description: Check dialogue assignments chapter by chapter. Preview individual lines with supported voices and correct uncertain results.

steps.title: Generate and listen
steps.description: Start a narration job, follow its progress, then play or download the finished MP3.

en.featureHeading: Characters, scripts, and audio in one place
en.featureIntro: Keep characters, scripts, and audio in one workflow so later changes have a clear starting point.

features.title: Keep character voices consistent
features.description: Reuse character profiles and voices across a series. Supported speech services can also provide scene-specific voice variants.

features.title: You decide who is speaking
features.description: AI helps identify narration, dialogue, and speakers. Correct assignments, accept suggestions, and approve the script before production.

features.title: Follow progress and review new versions
features.description: Track, cancel, and retry narration jobs. Series rebuilds produce a candidate version before you confirm the switch to the new audio.

features.title: Organize books and share reading
features.description: Order books into collections and share read-only access by another registered user's email. Private notes and narration audio are excluded.

en.factsHeading: A few things to know before you start

facts.label: Input and output
facts.value: Import EPUB or UTF-8 TXT; export audiobooks as MP3.

facts.label: Language and voices
facts.value: Taiwan-Mandarin-first production, primarily for Traditional Chinese content. Available voices depend on deployment settings and speech services.

facts.label: Hosting and cost
facts.value: MIT licensed and self-hosted. Budget separately for servers, GPUs, and any external speech services.

facts.label: Content and data
facts.value: Use content you own or are authorized to transform. No DRM circumvention. External models or speech services receive the text or audio needed for their work.

faqs.question: Do I have to start with multiple characters?
faqs.answer: No. Import a book and use a single voice available in your deployment. Add a series cast and a reviewed narration script when you want a multi-character production.

faqs.question: Will AI identify every character and line correctly?
faqs.answer: No guarantee. AI suggests characters and speakers; ambiguous or low-confidence passages still need human review. You can correct assignments before confirming the script.

faqs.question: Can I give a character a custom voice?
faqs.answer: The character voice studio supports creating and managing custom voices. Actual availability depends on configured speech services, samples, and authorization. Audition a voice before using it for a whole book.

faqs.question: Does installation enable every AI feature?
faqs.answer: Models and speech services still need configuration. Local LLMs, GPU speech, the public voice catalog, and developer APIs have separate availability requirements shown in the interface.

faqs.question: Are my books and audio public?
faqs.answer: Workspaces require sign-in and restrict books and generated audio by account. You can explicitly share read-only collections. Self-hosting does not mean every computation is local; data flow depends on the models and speech services you choose.
